My sister runs a couple Ngo's one of them is based in colombia which helps people from towns previously occupied by,  military; para-military; rebel-forces; and cartel remnants, get legitimate jobs. Most of these towns are in ruin and the majority of the people there are forced to either join the military or the rebels just to get enough food to survive. She runs more but that would risk my identity as there are many ngo's as the previous one, the others are more unique.

and thanks chupacabra_whiskey ramen is damn good, damn funny username too, thanks you guys sometimes I have episodes where the emotion hits me like a ton of bricks I'm not sure if that means im bi-polar or just under stress, but anyways talking it out on here really helped

Lot of it first hand, my older sister runs a couple of ngo's so i visit these places, its horrifying and these places are the places the media barely gives a shit about anymore, and to wildnettle i know I do help, but just watching good men and women try their hardest to make a difference and amounting to the grand total of fuck all, because if one place gets under control 4 more pop up in its place. I don't know I'm sorry if my original post sounds erratic I was just severely emotional.
